headline: Varun Beverages Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - We would like to inform you that Varun Beverages (Zimbabwe) (Private) Limited, subsidiary company, has incorporated a joint venture company in Zimbabwe namely  Varun Beverages Holding (Zimbabwe) (Private) Limited .
